# Incident Telemetry Service

Multi-View SaaS Operations Platform

Create a SaaS service health monitor portal with analytics, user registration, and incident tracking

## Application Views & Architecture
- Multi-view Interactive UI: Overview, Operations & Telemetry, Analytics, Users & Settings
- Persistence: File-backed JSON store (`data/store.json`) with schema validation
